news.models module¶

class news.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Model

Model representing a news article.

Fields: - title: The article’s title. - content: The article’s full content. - author: The independent journalist who wrote the article. - publisher: The publisher responsible for the article. - created_at: The date and time the article was created. - approved: Whether an editor has approved the article.

Each article must have either an author or a publisher, but not both.

class news.models.Newsletter(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Model

Model representing a newsletter containing selected articles.

Fields: - title: The newsletter’s title. - description: A description of the newsletter. - created_at: The date and time the newsletter was created. - author: The journalist who created the newsletter. - articles: Articles included in the newsletter.

news.views module¶

Views for the news application.

news.views.api_approved(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Record an article approval integration request.

news.views.api_article_detail(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Retrieve, update, or delete an article according to user role.

news.views.api_article_list(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

List approved articles or allow journalists to create articles.

news.views.api_subscribed_articles(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Return approved articles from the reader’s subscriptions.

news.views.approve_article(request, article_id)[source]¶

Approve an article, email subscribers, and call the API.

news.views.article_detail(request, article_id)[source]¶

Display approved article.

news.views.article_list(request)[source]¶

Display all approved articles.

news.views.create_article(request)[source]¶

Allow journalists to create independent or publisher articles.

news.views.create_newsletter(request)[source]¶

Allow journalists and editors to create newsletters.

news.views.create_publisher(request)[source]¶

Allow editors and administrators to create publishers.

news.views.dashboard(request)[source]¶

Display a dashboard based on the user’s role.

news.views.delete_article(request, article_id)[source]¶

Allow editors or the article’s journalist to delete an article.

news.views.delete_newsletter(request, newsletter_id)[source]¶

Allow editors or the newsletter’s journalist to delete it.

news.views.edit_article(request, article_id)[source]¶

Allow editors or the article’s journalist to edit an article.

news.views.edit_newsletter(request, newsletter_id)[source]¶

Allow editors or the newsletter’s journalist to edit it.

news.views.journalist_list(request)[source]¶

Display journalists that readers can subscribe to.

news.views.manage_publishers(request)[source]¶

Allow editors and administrators to manage publishers.

news.views.my_subscriptions(request)[source]¶

Display the publishers and journalists a reader follows.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, newsletter_id)[source]¶

Display a newsletter and its articles.

news.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]¶

Display newsletters to readers and other users.

news.views.publisher_list(request)[source]¶

Display publishers that readers can subscribe to.

news.views.register(request)[source]¶

Register a new user and allow them to select a role.

news.views.review_articles(request)[source]¶

Display articles awaiting editorial approval.

Allow access to users with a role or matching Django group.

news.views.subscribe_publisher(request, publisher_id)[source]¶
